data.algorithm: For each sample/channel, g=sum(predicted_CFA*observed_CFA)/max(sum(predicted_CFA**2),1e-12), then output=prediction*g. Fit all native256 CFA samples; both green phases contribute. No masks, clipping, shrinkage, reference/target or fitted display. FP64 sums/multiply, cast result once toFP32.
